sample.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
sample.text: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

sample.title: CVE-2024-10441: Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output Vulnerability
sample.text: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.

sample.title: CVE-2026-132696: Improper Access Control vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - OATHAuth Extensi
sample.text: Improper Access Control vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - OATHAuth Extension. This vulnerability is associated with program files src/HTMLForm/RecoveryCodesRemoveTemporaryForm.php, src/HTMLForm/RecoveryCodesStatusForm.php, src/Module/RecoveryCodes.php, src/Special/OATHManage.php. This issue affects MediaWiki - OATHAuth Extension: from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3.

sample.title: CVE-2026-135727: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in rfc4175_han
sample.text: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an uninitialized memory disclosure vulnerability in rfc4175_handle_packet() in libavformat/rtpdec_rfc4175.c that leaks heap contents into decoded video frames. Attackers can send RTP streams containing only some scan lines of a frame, leaving av_malloc buffer bytes uninitialized and exposing process heap memory in displayed, stored or re-streamed video.

sample.title: CVE-2026-136185: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication
sample.text: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

sample.title: CVE-2026-121725: A maliciously crafted IFCZIP file, when imported through Autodesk Revit or Autodesk IFC fo
sample.text: A maliciously crafted IFCZIP file, when imported through Autodesk Revit or Autodesk IFC for Revit Add-in, can exploit a path traversal flaw to write attacker-controlled files outside the intended extraction directory. Depending on the destination, a written file may later be loaded or executed, potentially resulting in code execution in the context of the current user. Exploitation requires user interaction to open or import the file.

sample.title: CVE-2026-100965: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker could
sample.text: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause an uncaught exception. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to denial of service.

sample.title: CVE-2026-135692: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a PHP object injecti
sample.text: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.17 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain a PHP object injection vulnerability in app/Casts/EncryptStringCast.php that unserializes decrypted attributes without class restrictions. Authenticated attackers can store a serialized gadget chain in encrypted fields like device passwords, triggering command execution as the web server user when read via GET /api/devices.
